features.quote: The escape hatch tool is the key design choice
features.justification_quote: Without this tool you can't tell helpless persistence from instructed persistence.

features.quote: Do not include "never give up"-style pressure in v1

Early termination: stop the run when the cheap automated detector (§4) fires on 4 consecutive turns.
features.justification_quote: Saves ~30–40% of tokens; the judge confirms post hoc.
